title: USHMM: Germany invaded Poland on 1 September 1939
summary: The Holocaust Encyclopedia states the invasion as the start of the European war.
body: The United States Holocaust Memorial Museum's encyclopedia says Germany started World War II in Europe by invading Poland on 1 September 1939. That is a dated military fact from a major archival institution. It does not settle the long argument about the Treaty of Versailles, appeasement, and expansion as causes. Those interpretations are separate and, in this pack, mostly unsourced. Britain and France's declarations of war are not in the sentence we used.
